incident_summary: Plan 23-05 initial execution attempted via Pencil's batch_design but Pencil's active editor silently switched mid-phase to a different project's .pen file (/Users/joel/Desktop/Projects/tonnetz-layout/.planning/designs/phase-4/phase-4-highlight-and-toggle.pen). User manually switched Pencil's active editor back to design/Crito.pen and executor re-ran the reference frame build with literal hex/font values (OPEN-23-13 — batch_design rejects $<var> references). The 39 primitives from plan 23-03 had already landed on disk in Crito.pen at the time of the editor switch. The 56 semantic aliases were in Pencil's in-memory state for the wrong file at the moment of plan 23-05 attempt 1; after the user restored the editor focus to Crito.pen, get_variables({}) returned all 95 variables correctly — confirming the semantic aliases had been persisted to Crito.pen's variable surface before the editor switch (only the reference frame build was lost). See OPEN-23-14 for full incident documentation.
